goal: Build official Linux release binaries as fully static executables
Allow bitcoind to run on non-glibc systems like Alpine and distributions with older glibc versions
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now as nothing invalidates review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: static glibc breaks when dynamic NSS resolvers load mismatched host glibc (luke-jr)
Verified by testing across Alpine, NixOS, and older Linux releases (jsarenik, 0xB10C, hebasto, theStack)
Strong support for static-pie release binaries over musl alternatives (theuni, willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because official Linux binaries can run on non-glibc systems like Alpine and older distributions
Removes a recurring platform compatibility hurdle while aiding binary security hardening
